messages:
Maria: quick heads-up — saw circuit-breaker flips on /embeddings during last hour spike. lots of mixed-dim batches (64/768/1536). preflight classified them as incompatible so many routed to fallback; then they retried to main and breaker tripped :grimacing:
AJ: ouch. any debounce on routing? sounds like thrash
Cheng: router currently: per-request preflight + immediate decision. no debounce. also we increment same circuit counter on fallback and on 413 fails — double-counting possible
Maria: that's the smoke. proposal: short debounce (200-500ms) per-source to collapse rapid flip-flops
Sophia: agree. console needs to surface both "routed->main" and "routed->fallback" separately. otherwise ops just see breaker opens and flags model
Kevin: add telemetry tags: dim_profile (d64/d768/d1536) and batch_count. drop boolean mixed_dims flag. allows slicing
Maria: suggested config snippet:
```
router.circuit.window_ms=300
router.circuit.failure_threshold=10
router.circuit.decrement_after_ms=60000
router.circuit.count_keys=["customer_id","dim_profile"]
```
AJ: dim_profile grouping is good, but per-dim counters could reduce smoothing. add cross_dim_bucket override so some tenants pool
Cheng: default per-dim, add cross_dim_bucket toggle. also add fast-path headers so preflight isn't heavy: X-Embed-Dims and X-Embed-Count
Sophia: console widgets to add:
- timeseries: circuit_state per-tenant
- stacked: routed_main vs routed_fallback vs fastfail
- heatmap: mixed-dim churn
Deploy Bot: deploy queued: router-service v2.14.3 -> canary 10% in 10m
Maria: soft-fail idea: when circuit opens, keep routing 20% to fallback for graceful degradation
Ops: quota idea: use weighted quota = tokens * dim_multiplier (e.g., 768 -> 1.0, 384 -> 0.6) not raw token caps
Kevin: telemetry sampling: sample 1% of high-volume customers; ensure each dim_profile has min N samples/min
Cheng: implementation plan:
1) prefer header hints
2) quick preflight if missing, debounce results for 300ms
3) circuit counters tagged by (customer,dim_profile)
4) emit event route_decision with dims/count/sampled
Maria: need console toggle to flip cross_dim_bucket per-tenant for a handful of customers
Sophia: I'll mock toggle + rollout blurb
AJ: SDKs need to add headers; if SDKs lag, router must still be safe — debounce helps
Infra Bot: alert rule proposal: fire when circuit_open_rate > 2% for >5m AND fallback_routing > 10%
Maria: next steps: Cheng prototype debounce+dim counters; Kevin telemetry schema & sampling; Sophia console widgets; AJ SDK headers doc. filing mini-RFC, priority P2 :thumbsup:
